title: The Parts menu, page title and browser tab read Part Library
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location, so the Part Library lists an entry to open.
  • Start on the Work Orders page (Work Orders in the top bar).
custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top bar.
  2. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  4. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Under PARTS the left menu reads "Inventory" and "Part Library"; there is no "Catalog" entry.

Step 2:

  • The page title reads "Part Library".
  • The browser tab's title reads "Part Library".

Step 3:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 4:

  • On the entry's detail page the browser tab's title reads "Library Part".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S12-R1: “The Parts left menu entry reads "Part Library".”
  • S12-R2: “The page title on that screen reads "Part Library".”
  • S12-R12: “The browser tab titles read "Part Library" on the list and "Library Part" on an entry's detail page.”
  • Story 12, context note: “Context note: a catalog is something a shop buys from. This list is the shop's own record of the parts it knows, which is a library.”
